rows.response_text: Oil and gas are both used for heating, transportation, and electricity generation, but in slightly different ways. Oil is found only in the ground, while gas can also be produced by decaying organic matter. Gas is considered better for the environment than oil, particularly in terms of greenhouse gas emissions. The price of natural gas has been relatively stable in recent years, while oil prices have been high and rising, largely due to unrest in Middle Eastern oil-producing countries. Additionally, heating systems powered by oil have a longer life expectancy of 30 or more years, compared to natural gas systems that last 11-14 years.
